modules.title: Source, tokens and execution
modules.description: Read text into tokens, define expression order and execute checked instructions.

modules.title: Optional native-system study
modules.description: Connect an interpreter to a Kernel programme and understand the firmware boundary.

modules.title: Design a small language
modules.description: Specify syntax and failures before observing bytecode and execution budgets.

modules.title: Project: an instruction viewer
modules.description: Display instructions, admit literals, check stack shape and publish a bounded execution result.

modules.title: Use a Small Language in Studio
modules.description: Build an arithmetic starter, trace its Framework recipe, select the preview profile, observe incremental checks, exercise negative cases and plan language extensions.

modules.title: Inspect and Embed a Small Compiler
modules.description: Inspect resource requirements without executing a program, trace stack behavior, distinguish structural checks from arithmetic checks, embed the shared library and design precise boundary tests.

modules.title: Observe bounded execution across consumers
modules.description: Read successful and failed arithmetic states, own trace buffers, connect Framework presentation state and qualify a native Kernel consumer.

modules.title: Extend integer expressions with comparisons
modules.description: Follow a bounded language extension from token recognition and precedence to canonical wire profiles, Framework preview and Kernel consumer evidence.

modules.title: Compile and qualify logical negation
modules.description: Reuse canonical comparison operations while preserving token boundaries, operand errors and execution evidence.

modules.title: Linked compiler and runtime profiles
modules.description: Query actual components and validate declared features with independent operations.

modules.title: Native linkage and trustworthy test fixtures
modules.description: Trace archive composition, exact literal bytes and type-correct regression observations with a standalone C lab.

modules.title: Bounded integer spellings and evidence
modules.description: Implement radix admission without changing existing runtime meaning, then qualify range, wire and span contracts.

modules.title: Execution and supervision budgets
modules.description: Distinguish exact VM instruction fuel from bounded host process and test-suite deadlines.

modules.title: Configuration input observation
modules.description: Observe declared inputs, test stale-record refusal and preserve literal data without claiming binary provenance.

modules.title: Native operation comparison and exit contracts
modules.description: Use the existing validated comparison service through a read-only command and distinguish results from errors.

modules.title: Buffered report failures
modules.description: Exercise the real CLI entry through a read-only native descriptor and preserve semantic result codes.

modules.title: Bounded local integers
modules.description: Follow name binding, assignment and runtime proof across a canonical bytecode extension.

modules.title: Short-circuit control flow
modules.description: Lower logical expressions, prove path joins and compare a defined corpus with native C.

modules.title: Conditional values and parser recursion
modules.description: Reuse forward branches for integer selection and prove both recursive arms respect shared parser bounds.

modules.title: Checked compound assignments
modules.description: Extend local update grammar through existing runtime operations and qualify exact semantics without a wire-format change.

modules.title: Braced conditional statements
modules.description: Lower statement branches, share parser bounds and verify selected paths in independent consumers.

modules.title: Ordered else-if chains
modules.description: Extend false-path parsing while retaining exact fuel, shared depth and existing runtime records.

modules.title: Checked signed remainder
modules.description: Extend source and shared runtime with a canonical arithmetic wire profile and independent consumer evidence.

modules.title: Signed unary complement
modules.description: Lower signed bit inversion through existing checked arithmetic and qualify independent consumers.

modules.title: Binary bitwise operators
modules.description: Implement eager signed bitwise operations and preserve canonical bytecode compatibility.

modules.title: Bounded execution and shared consumers
modules.description: Trace the current native contracts, qualify their boundaries and retain explicit limits.

modules.title: Further practical exercises
modules.description: Apply the earlier concepts to concrete code and checked outcomes.

modules.title: Check fixed names inside a block
modules.description: Resolve named integers through braces and observe which work the interpreter executes.

modules.title: Read local declarations
modules.description: Read equivalent signed types and check which local values can change.

modules.title: Use a script session
modules.description: Try one line at a time and preserve the last accepted value when a line fails.

modules.title: Store Boolean locals
modules.description: Trace zero and nonzero values through a local declaration, a checked update and a source-size query.

modules.title: Store unsigned byte locals
modules.description: Trace how an unsigned byte stores the remainder after groups of 256 are removed.

modules.title: Use the typed C console
modules.description: Choose an input mode, preview a change and submit one complete block.

modules.title: Read casts in complete C
modules.description: Predict the value of a cast and compare checked instruction files.
